export function listNames(lookup,ids,callback){const names=[];let index=0;function next(){if(index===ids.length)return callback(null,names);lookup(ids[index++],(err,user)=>{if(err)return callback(err);names.push(user.name);next();});}next();}
export async function listNamesAsync(lookup,ids){const out=[];for(const id of ids)out.push((await lookup(id)).name);return out;}

mutants.name: callback-multiple
mutants.replacement: export function createLookup(transport){return function lookup(id,callback){const invoke=done=>{let settled=false;const once=(...args)=>{settled=true;done(...args)};try{transport.get(id,once)}catch(e){once(e)}};if(typeof callback==='function'){invoke(callback);return undefined;}return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>invoke((err,value)=>err?reject(err):resolve(value)));};}

export function listNames(lookup,ids,callback){const names=[];let index=0;function next(){if(index===ids.length)return callback(null,names);lookup(ids[index++],(err,user)=>{if(err)return callback(err);names.push(user.name);next();});}next();}
export async function listNamesAsync(lookup,ids){const values=await Promise.all(ids.map(id=>lookup(id)));return values.reverse().map(x=>x.name);}
